readings: Among patients whose average HGB across their lab records (ignoring NULLs) is above the overall average HGB, where the overall average is taken over all individual lab records in the Laboratory table (every record weighted equally, ignoring NULLs), list the patient ID, their average HGB, how far it is above that record-level overall average, and their average minus the mean of these above-average patients' per-patient averages. Show the top 10 by that last value, highest first, unrounded.

Among patients whose average HGB across their lab records (ignoring NULLs) is above the overall average HGB, where the overall average is the mean of the per-patient average HGB values (every patient weighted equally, regardless of how many lab records they have), list the patient ID, their average HGB, how far it is above that patient-level overall average, and their average minus the mean of these above-average patients' per-patient averages. Show the top 10 by that last value, highest first, unrounded.
queries:
WITH pa AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) AS o FROM Laboratory
),
above AS (
  SELECT pa.ID, pa.avg_hgb, pa.avg_hgb - overall.o AS diff_overall
  FROM pa, overall
  WHERE pa.avg_hgb > overall.o
)
SELECT ID,
       avg_hgb,
       diff_overall,
       avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM above) AS diff_from_above_mean
FROM above
ORDER BY diff_from_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall FROM p
),
a AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall
  FROM p, o
  WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS above_mean FROM a
)
SELECT a.ID,
       a.avg_hgb,
       a.avg_hgb - a.overall AS above_overall,
       a.avg_hgb - m.above_mean AS diff_from_above_mean
FROM a, m
ORDER BY diff_from_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
